# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Friday, October 23, 2026

*Saturday, Oct 24, 2026 edition, covering Friday 23 October. Muthoot Fincorp Ltd is a separate company from Muthoot Finance Ltd; Muthoot Finance appears here as a listed lender.*

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

**1. Shriram Finance: profit +59%, but gold-loan Stage 3 jumped and the stock fell. Gold-loan stress now has a fourth large NBFC behind it.**
- Q2 FY27 standalone PAT **₹3,677 cr (+59.4% YoY)**, ahead of the LSEG consensus of ₹3,546 cr. AUM **₹3.29 lakh cr (+17%)**, NIM **9.52%** (8.19% a year ago), disbursements **₹54,079 cr (+25.7%)**. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/shriram-finance-q2-profit-jumps-59-yoy-to-rs-3677-crore-on-strong-interest-income-lower-funding-costs/articleshow/135150195.cms), [VCCircle/Reuters](https://www.vccircle.com/shriramfinance-joins-peers-in-flagging-stress-in-gold-loans))
- Gold loans of **₹8,974 cr (+68.2%)** were the fastest-growing segment. Gold-loan **gross Stage 3 rose to 3.12%**, from 2.57% in Q1 and 2.28% a year ago. Company GS3 4.65% / NS3 2.31%, PCR 51.48%, credit cost 2.03% (1.68% a year ago). ([VCCircle/Reuters](https://www.vccircle.com/shriramfinance-joins-peers-in-flagging-stress-in-gold-loans), [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/earnings/shriram-finance-q2-results-shares-as-gross-net-stage-3-assets-rise-dividend-declared-20018042.htm))
- The stock settled about **4% lower at ₹865** and was the top Nifty loser. Shriram follows Bajaj Finance (Stage 2+3 up ₹1,601 cr in Q2, of which ₹1,047 cr was gold) and Piramal ("15–23% of industry gold disbursements went to customers who had been 90+ DPD at least once"). ([Mint](https://www.livemint.com/news/gold-loan-stress-nbfc-piramal-bajaj-finance-precious-metal-11792580129138.html))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Shriram is now a ₹9,000 cr gold lender still growing at about 68%, which adds competition for gold-loan lenders including Muthoot Fincorp, and analysts are likely to read Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 gold-loan asset quality against these peer disclosures.

**2. RBI Governor: Upper Layer NBFCs must list, and "public funds" means public funds. He backed RBI's position on Tata Sons.**
- At the NDTV World Summit on 23 Oct, Governor Malhotra said that UL NBFCs and CICs with access to public funds have to be registered, and that UL entities have to list. That backs the classification of Tata Sons, whose surrender application RBI rejected last month. He also said RBI's inflation projection averages about 5.1% and that RBI targets no particular rupee level. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/rbi-governor-backs-tata-sons-classification-says-large-nbfcs-must-follow-listing-norms/articleshow/135149254.cms), [DealStreetAsia](https://www.dealstreetasia.com/stories/rbi-listing-requirement-nbfcs-499056))
- **Speech, not a circular.**
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Muthoot Fincorp is a Middle Layer NBFC and is not on the 2026-27 Upper Layer list, so the listing requirement for Upper Layer NBFCs does not apply to it. Muthoot Finance is in the Upper Layer and is already listed.

**3. RBI Bulletin review of NBFCs: profits up, asset quality better, but share of financial-system assets down. Gold-jewellery loans up nearly 60%.**
- The October 2026 RBI Bulletin article "Performance of the NBFC Sector: Review for 2025" found that NBFCs' share of financial-sector assets slipped to **12.7% (Mar 2025)** from 13.9% (Mar 2020). UL+ML assets were **+19.4%** and loans **+24%** at Dec 2025. Gold-jewellery loans were up **nearly 60% YoY**. Borrowings rose **23.3%**, and over 77% of them came from banks and market instruments. GNPA was **2.7%**, NNPA **0.9%**, CRAR **25.2%**. The article flags bank interconnectedness. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/nbfcs-lose-ground-despite-stronger-profitability-better-asset-quality-rbi-study/article71617268.ece), [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/industry/banking/nbfcs-reliance-on-bank-borrowings-rises-amid-strong-credit-growth-rbi-126102301611_1.html), [RBI PR](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63859))
- A Bulletin article is research, not regulation.
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** The "bank borrowings and interconnectedness" theme is what supervisors have cited before tightening bank-to-NBFC risk weights, which would affect the cost of bank funding for NBFCs including Muthoot Fincorp.

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

- **Tranche I public NCD issue (open 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026).** Prospectus dated 19 Oct; ₹200 cr base issue plus ₹300 cr green-shoe option, for ₹500 cr within the ₹4,000 cr shelf; tenures of 24, 36, 60 and 72 months; to be listed on BSE. Proceeds are for onward lending and debt repayment. ([FintechBizNews](https://www.fintechbiznews.com/exchanges-ipos-nfos/muthoot-fincorp-rolls-out-ncd-tranche-i-aims-to-raise-rs5-bn), [Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/), [Nuvama prospectus](https://www.nuvama.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Muthoot-FinCorp-Limited-Tranche-I-Prospectus-dated-October-19-2026.pdf))
- **Day 1.** Bids stood at 0.55 times the base issue at the end of day 1. ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/))
- **Ratings.** The Tranche I NCDs are rated CRISIL AA/Stable and BWR AA+/Stable; CARE AA/Stable was assigned on 5 Oct. ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/))

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

- **Fri Oct 23 close:** Sensex **73,123.83 (−125.56, −0.17%)**, Nifty **22,600 (−87.65, −0.39%)**. That was the fourth straight loss. Week: Sensex −2.2%, Nifty −2.4%. Small- and midcaps had their **worst week in 20 months** (−7.3% / −5.6%). Every sector closed red. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-23rd-october-2026/article71611889.ece), [Moneycontrol live](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/stock-market-live-updates-nifty50-share-price-sensex-share-price-crude-fii-gift-nifty-rupee-latest-updates-23-10-2026-alpha-liveblog-14058065.html))
- **Financials:** Nifty Financial Services **24,403.00 (−1.03%)** (52-week low 23,373.95, set 2 Apr). Moneycontrol's intraday sector table had Nifty Bank around −1.5% and Capital Markets −2.6%. ([TrackLivePrice](https://trackliveprice.com/nifty-financial-services/), [Moneycontrol live](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/stock-market-live-updates-nifty50-share-price-sensex-share-price-crude-fii-gift-nifty-rupee-latest-updates-23-10-2026-alpha-liveblog-14058065.html))
- **Gold-loan peers (NSE close, 23 Oct):** Manappuram **₹286.10 (−5.23%)**. Muthoot Finance **₹2,373.00 (−1.74%)**, a fourth straight decline. ([Manappuram](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/MANAPPURAM?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-23&view=daily), [Muthoot Finance](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/MUTHOOTFIN?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-23&view=daily))
- **Flows (provisional, 23 Oct):** FII net **+₹887.65 cr** (a rare buy day), DII net **+₹3,235.36 cr**. ([Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/fiis-net-buy-rs-888-crore-of-indian-equities-while-diis-net-buy-rs-3459-crore-14058825.html))
- **Macro:** Brent ~**$114** after Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure. Rupee closed **94.93/$ (−12 paise)**. Gold this morning: spot **~$3,996/oz** (below $4,000), MCX Dec **~₹1,42,150/10g**. The US Fed meets **27–28 Oct**. ([Moneycontrol live](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/stock-market-live-updates-nifty50-share-price-sensex-share-price-crude-fii-gift-nifty-rupee-latest-updates-23-10-2026-alpha-liveblog-14058065.html), [Gold spot](https://exa.ai/library/markets/commodity/gold?currency=USD), [ET MCX gold](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/commoditysummary/symbol-GOLD.cms))

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

- **No new RBI circular addressed to NBFCs on 23 Oct.** RBI/2026-27/297 and /299 are Commercial Bank directions (capital adequacy, and op-risk capital under "Forthcoming Instructions"). /298 delegates FEMA compounding to Regional Offices (AD-I banks / authorised persons). The Leverage Ratio guidelines are for banks. ([RBI circular index](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_CircularIndexDisplay.aspx), [RBI press releases](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx))
- **RBI Bulletin, October 2026:** the NBFC sector review (Urgent #3). Research, not a rule. ([RBI PR](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63859))
- **SEBI, 23 Oct:** one circular, on call-record maintenance for Research Analysts. Not NBFC. ([SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0))
- **IBBI:** no new circular since 24 Sep. ([IBBI](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars))
- Governor's UL-listing remarks: Urgent #2 (speech, not a circular).
- More detail on the Rules page.

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

- **Shriram Finance (23 Oct):** headline in Urgent #1. More detail: NII ₹8,661 cr (+38%) on ET's basis (CNBC reports ₹8,414 cr on a different basis); provisions +41%; CAR **33.24%** after the MUFG capital; ROA 3.95%. Cost of funds is 8.41%, with incremental borrowing at about 7.3%. Management guides NIM of about 9% for the next two quarters. Interim dividend **₹6.50/share**, record date 29 Oct. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/shriram-finance-q2-profit-jumps-59-yoy-to-rs-3677-crore-on-strong-interest-income-lower-funding-costs/articleshow/135150195.cms), [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/earnings/shriram-finance-q2-results-shares-as-gross-net-stage-3-assets-rise-dividend-declared-20018042.htm), [AlphaStreet transcript](https://alphastreet.com/india/shriram-finance-limited-shriramfin-q2-2027-earnings-call-transcript/))
- **IREDA (reported this week):** standalone PAT ₹554 cr (vs ₹549 cr), disbursements **₹10,579 cr (+31%)**, loan book **₹97,411 cr (+15%)**, NNPA 1.08% (1.97% a year ago). ([Construction World](https://www.constructionworld.in/energy-infrastructure/power-and-renewable-energy/ireda-net-profit-rises-to-rs.-5.54-bn-in-q2-fy27/99244))
- **Coming up:** Cholamandalam and PNB Housing on **28 Oct**. Muthoot Finance and Manappuram have not reported Q2 yet (Mint, 21 Oct). ([Mint](https://www.livemint.com/news/gold-loan-stress-nbfc-piramal-bajaj-finance-precious-metal-11792580129138.html))

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

- **No fresh NBFC rating actions confirmed for 23 Oct.**
- Earlier in October and not yet flagged in this daily: **PNB Housing Finance was upgraded by CRISIL to AAA/Stable** (6 Oct). ([CRISIL](https://www.crisilratings.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/PNBHousingFinanceLimited_October%2006_%202026_RR_407013.html))
- Muthoot Fincorp's ratings are unchanged (see the Muthoot Fincorp section below).

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

- **PNB Housing Finance** raised **₹253.65 cr** in a private-placement NCD at **8.4552%**, maturing 2031. ([Whalesbook](https://www.whalesbook.com/corporate-news/English/bankingfinance/PNB-Housing-Finance-Raises-Rs-25365-Crore-Via-NCD-Private-Placement/6adb0e98c6c6dccbb905246c))
- **IIFL Finance** (gold-loan peer) is reported to be planning to raise **₹2,500–5,000 cr** by selling a 10–20% stake, amid Fairfax-exit talk. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/iifl-finance-plans-to-raise-2500-5000-crore-by-selling-stake-amid-fairfax-exit-rumors/articleshow/135034841.cms))
- **Purple Finance** plans to enter affordable housing finance (AUM about ₹853 cr after the Saksham acquisition). ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/purple-finance-plans-entry-into-affordable-housing-finance-segment/article71615290.ece))
- **PFC–REC:** RBI NoC received on 15 Oct. Shareholder and creditor approvals are still pending (see Deep Dive). ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/rbi-gives-noc-to-pfc-rec-merger/article71591605.ece))

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

- **No significant new developments on 23 Oct.** Context still live: CRISIL says personal-loan NBFCs' adjusted 90+ DPD fell to **6.6% (Mar 2026)** from 8.5%, with AUM growth seen at about 50% this fiscal to about ₹2 lakh cr. ([CRISIL](https://www.crisilratings.com/en/home/newsroom/press-releases/2026/10/risk-recalibration-begins-to-pay-off-for-personal-loan-nbfcs.html)) Account-aggregator-enabled lending was about **₹3.82 lakh cr in FY26** (CRIF). AA pricing starts on 1 Nov. ([CRIF AA report](https://www.crifhighmark.com/media/7697/account-aggregator-report-october-26.pdf))

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

- **Gold-loan stress, now four names deep.** Shriram's gold GS3 is 3.12% (Urgent #1). From Mint's 21 Oct round-up: IIFL Finance gold bad loans rose to 0.9% from 0.6% in Q1, and Fedbank's stage 3 to 0.5% from 0.1%. Piramal says 35% of gold customers now borrow from a second lender (20–25% two years ago). NBFC jewellery loans were **₹3.64 trn (+69% YoY)** at end-August. Gold prices in India are down about 3% since April. ([Mint](https://www.livemint.com/news/gold-loan-stress-nbfc-piramal-bajaj-finance-precious-metal-11792580129138.html))
- **System:** in the RBI Bulletin review, NBFC GNPA was 2.7% and NNPA 0.9% (Dec 2025). ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/nbfcs-lose-ground-despite-stronger-profitability-better-asset-quality-rbi-study/article71617268.ece))
- **ARC market:** no new transactions on 23 Oct.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

- **LIC Housing Finance:** shareholders approved **Sandeep Kumar as MD & CEO** with 98.96% support (postal ballot closed 22 Oct). ([Whalesbook](https://www.whalesbook.com/corporate-news/English/bankingfinance/LIC-Housing-Finance-Appoints-Sandeep-Kumar-as-MD-and-CEO/6adb5c30c6c6dccbb905db1f))
- ETBFSI's weekly roundup also lists **Piramal Finance appointing former SBI chairman Dinesh Kumar Khara** as Independent Director (effective 19 Oct; already flagged). ([ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/industry/bfsi-leadership-roundup-piramal-finance-bajaj-general-insurance-indusind-securities-others-announce-key-appointments/135159300))

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Infrastructure & Project Finance *(Saturday focus)*

- **PFC–REC is the structural story.** RBI gave its NoC on 15 Oct. If shareholders and creditors approve, the merged entity would have a **loan book above ₹11 lakh cr**. The swap ratio is 88 PFC shares for every 100 REC shares. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/rbi-gives-noc-to-pfc-rec-merger/article71591605.ece))
- **PFC keeps incubating transmission SPVs.** It has incorporated Solapur SEZ and Karur REZ transmission SPVs, plus an SPV for a **₹4,378 cr Northern Region STATCOM** scheme. The SPVs are bid out to developers. ([Kalkine](https://www.kalkine.co.in/article/announcements/power-finance-corporation-nsepfc-why-did-it-incorporate-two-new-transmission-spvs), [PowerPeak Digest](https://powerpeakdigest.com/pfc-northern-region-grid-statcom-spv/))
- **Renewables credit is still growing fast.** IREDA's disbursements were +31% and its loan book +15%, with NNPA falling to 1.08%. ([Construction World](https://www.constructionworld.in/energy-infrastructure/power-and-renewable-energy/ireda-net-profit-rises-to-rs.-5.54-bn-in-q2-fy27/99244))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Infrastructure finance does not compete with gold lending. The indirect link is bond-market supply: heavy AAA issuance by PFC, REC and IREDA can keep AA credit spreads, which apply to issuers such as Muthoot Fincorp, from compressing.

reports.title: What changed in the rules
reports.content:
# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Saturday, 24 October 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

No new RBI/SEBI circulars or regulatory changes related to NBFCs were found today.

RBI issued three numbered instruments on **23 Oct**, but all three are addressed to **commercial banks or AD-I banks**, not NBFCs. SEBI's 23 Oct circular is for research analysts. IBBI has nothing new. **`RBI/2026-27/296` (19 Oct, UAPA)** is still the last NBFC-addressed RBI instrument.

### What is in the market that is *not* an NBFC circular

| Item | What it actually is |
|------|---------------------|
| **`RBI/2026-27/297`** (23 Oct): Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy **Eleventh Amendment** Directions, 2026 | Rewrites the banks' **leverage-ratio** chapter to the Basel *Leverage Ratio 2017* standard: **D-SIBs 4%, other banks 3.5%**, effective **1 Apr 2027**. [RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13743) · [PR 63854](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63854) · [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/rbi-updates-leverage-ratio-framework-for-banks/article71617234.ece) |
| **`RBI/2026-27/299`** (23 Oct): Commercial Banks – Forthcoming Instructions **Second Amendment** Directions | Bank-side forthcoming-instructions bundle. [RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx) |
| **`RBI/FED/2026-27/298`**, A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 28 (23 Oct): FEMA compounding delegated to Regional Offices | FED circular for AD-I banks and authorised persons. [RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx) |
| **RBI Bulletin, October 2026** (PR 63859): article *Performance of the NBFC Sector: Review for 2025* | This is a **staff study, not a Direction**. It says NBFCs lost share even with better profitability and asset quality. [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/nbfcs-lose-ground-despite-stronger-profitability-better-asset-quality-rbi-study/article71617268.ece) |
| **Governor on UL / CIC listing** (23 Oct, reported) | A speech backing the Tata Sons classification and saying large NBFCs must follow the listing norms. [ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/rbi-governor-backs-tata-sons-classification-says-large-nbfcs-must-follow-listing-norms/articleshow/135149254.cms) |
| **SEBI circular (23 Oct)**: research-analyst call records | Applies to research analysts and intermediaries. [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0) |
| **SEBI NCS list** | The three **7 Oct** items (MB skip, ISIN 12+5, Risk-o-Meter) are still the latest NCS rows. |
| **RBI drafts** | Latest is still **11 Sep** (KYC mule-SOP, banks). Interest Rate Directions draft **12 Aug**; revolving-credit draft **6 Aug**. [Drafts](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx) |
| **IBBI** | Last circulars are dated **24 Sep**; site stamp is **08 Oct**. **II/106 (21 Sep)** is still the PG interim-moratorium line. [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars) |

Primary sources checked this morning (IST): [RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx), whose latest dated block is **Oct 23, 2026** (297/298/299); [RBI circular index](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_CircularIndexDisplay.aspx); [Press Releases](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx); [Drafts](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx); [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0); [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars).

---

## ⏰ What did *not* move overnight

| Item | Status | Next date |
|------|--------|-----------|
| **Q2 FY27 / LODR 52** | Books frozen at 30 Sep. | **14 Nov 2026** (21 days) |
| **Credit Risk-o-Meter** | Issued 7 Oct; live 45 days later. | **21 Nov 2026** (28 days) |
| **SNFA / IRAC 3rd Amendment** | Live since 1 Oct. Gold jewellery is **not** SNFA. | Legacy reversal by **30 Sep 2027** |
| **SC repossession judgment (16 Sep)** | Still no RBI circular. | Watch DoR/DoS |
| Revolving-credit draft (6 Aug) | Still a draft. | Final expected ~Nov 2026 |
| Interest Rate Directions draft (12 Aug) | Comments closed 11 Sep. | Effective **1 Apr 2027** if finalised |
| Recovery agents (RBC 3rd Amd, 6 Aug) | IIBF certification, 08:00–19:00 calling window, call recording. | **1 Jan 2027** (69 days) |
| Type I deregistration | Window open. | **31 Dec 2026** (68 days) |
| NBFC-AA interoperability | Announced; not yet a numbered Direction. | **31 Dec 2026** |
| Bank leverage ratio (297) | New. Banks only. | 1 Apr 2027 |
| Repo | **5.50%** after the October hike. | Next MPC |

---

## 📅 Regulatory calendar

- **14 Nov 2026:** last date for Q2 FY27 results of listed debt issuers under SEBI LODR Regulation 52.
- **21 Nov 2026:** SEBI Credit Risk-o-Meter disclosure applies to new debt offer documents.
- **31 Dec 2026:** Type I NBFC deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability window closes.
- **1 Jan 2027:** recovery-agent requirements under the RBC Third Amendment take effect.
- **1 Apr 2027:** Interest Rate Directions take effect, if finalised.
- **30 Sep 2027:** last date to reverse unrealised pre-SNFA interest on legacy SNFA stock.

cards.title: Shriram Finance: profit +59%, but gold-loan Stage 3 jumped and the stock fell. Gold-loan stress now has a fourth large NBFC behind it.
cards.summary: Q2 FY27 standalone PAT ₹3,677 cr (+59.4% YoY) , ahead of the LSEG consensus of ₹3,546 cr. AUM ₹3.29 lakh cr (+17%) , NIM 9.52% (8.19% a year ago), disbursements ₹54,079 cr (+25.7%) . (ET, VCCircle/Reuters) - Gold loans of ₹8,974 cr (+68.2%) were the fastest-growing segment.
cards.impact: Shriram is now a ₹9,000 cr gold lender still growing at about 68%, which adds competition for gold-loan lenders including Muthoot Fincorp, and analysts are likely to read Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 gold-loan asset quality against these peer disclosures.

cards.title: RBI Governor: Upper Layer NBFCs must list, and "public funds" means public funds. He backed RBI's position on Tata Sons.
cards.summary: At the NDTV World Summit on 23 Oct, Governor Malhotra said that UL NBFCs and CICs with access to public funds have to be registered, and that UL entities have to list. That backs the classification of Tata Sons, whose surrender application RBI rejected last month.
cards.impact: Muthoot Fincorp is a Middle Layer NBFC and is not on the 2026-27 Upper Layer list, so the listing requirement for Upper Layer NBFCs does not apply to it. Muthoot Finance is in the Upper Layer and is already listed.

cards.title: RBI Bulletin review of NBFCs: profits up, asset quality better, but share of financial-system assets down. Gold-jewellery loans up nearly 60%.
cards.summary: The October 2026 RBI Bulletin article "Performance of the NBFC Sector: Review for 2025" found that NBFCs' share of financial-sector assets slipped to 12.7% (Mar 2025) from 13.9% (Mar 2020). UL+ML assets were +19.4% and loans +24% at Dec 2025.
cards.impact: The "bank borrowings and interconnectedness" theme is what supervisors have cited before tightening bank-to-NBFC risk weights, which would affect the cost of bank funding for NBFCs including Muthoot Fincorp.

cards.summary: Prospectus dated 19 Oct; ₹200 cr base issue plus ₹300 cr green-shoe option, for ₹500 cr within the ₹4,000 cr shelf; tenures of 24, 36, 60 and 72 months; to be listed on BSE. Proceeds are for onward lending and debt repayment.
